description_zh: 福特皮卡（ego）在红灯前追尾前方静止的雷克萨斯，测试自动驾驶能否对同车道停止车辆及时制动。选择后车福特作为ego，前车为静止障碍。

source_snippets: a test vehicle operating in manual driving mode was stopped at a red light after exiting Highway 101 to turn right onto Lawrence Expressway when a Ford pickup made contact from the rear.

VEH 1: A. STOPPED (checked), H. SLOWING/STOPPING (checked)
VEH 2: D. MAKING RIGHT TURN (checked)
TYPE OF COLLISION: VEH 1: C. REAR END (checked)
evidence.reason: 前车静止在红灯处，后车追尾，后车作为ego具有测试价值，可用stopped_ahead表达前车静止，符合现有词汇表。
